verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides built-in, GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD with YAML workflows and reuse of existing Actions (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15). It also integrates with deployment-oriented tools such as Argo CD, Drone, Woodpecker and Jenkins, plus webhooks (gitea-docs-20, gitea-docs-4). Community users report running Gitea with Drone for years (gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-14). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deployment-specific features (environments, deployment secrets/approvals, deploy targets), and hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions itself performing deployments.
